canon-dune:kaitain.x: Seat of the Padishah Emperor and House Corrino following the devastation of Salusa Secundus.

new-horizons.x: Fifth solar-escape spacecraft; conducted flybys of Pluto (2015) and Kuiper Belt contact binary 486958 Arrokoth (2019).

proxima-centauri-d.x: Sub-Earth candidate orbiting Proxima Centauri every 5.1 days at just 4.25 light-years, one of the lightest known extrasolar planets.

gaia-4792774797545800832.x: Young, massive super-Jupiter embedded in a massive debris disk, completing an entire rotation in just 8.1 hours (equatorial speed ~100,000 km/h).

hip-25930.x: Multiple star system situated almost exactly on the celestial equator, forming the western end of Orion’s Belt.
hip-25930.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3

hip-61084.x: Closest red giant star to Earth (88 ly), crowning the northern apex of the Southern Cross.
hip-61084.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3

hip-61941.x: Famous binary system of two near-identical yellow-white main-sequence stars with a 169-year eccentric orbit.
hip-61941.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3

hip-86032.x: Brightest star in Ophiuchus (48.6 ly), a rapid rotator marking the head of the Serpent Bearer.
hip-86032.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3
